justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/chain/CompileChainWalker.java and CompileNode.java; this package contains only these 2 classes. Its direct consumers are only ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/compilechain/CompileChainStage.java and core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestCompileChain.java. The package’s outgoing dependencies are limited to shared core/model/util/compilation/logger types (for example CompilationUtil, Compilation, IParseDictionary, IReadOnlyJITDataModel, ParseUtil), and those shared packages are widely used elsewhere in the repo (rg found 195 Java files importing model/util/compilation/core symbols).
